reader.requirement: At --std 85 USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR PROCEDURE and USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE must be the same statement for every target (file-names of any organization, INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O, EXTEND), while the 1985 format still requires AFTER and PROCEDURE and admits exactly one of the two words.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 refuses Format 1 without AFTER (use-without-after-2002) or without PROCEDURE (use-without-procedure-2002); the EXCEPTION/ERROR alternation is not consulted

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: ERROR and EXCEPTION are one alternation in the grammar and no binder or emitter reads which was written (grep ERROR()|EXCEPTION() in the compiler finds only unrelated sites)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf27_04 covers sequential files named explicitly; mode targets and relative/indexed files under each spelling are not exercised

probes.printed: USE AFTER ERROR PROCEDURE ON SQ RL IX IR NX fires for 38, 23 and 35; USE AFTER EXCEPTION PROCEDURE INPUT fires for 10 on an OPTIONAL relative file
probes.expected: GR5: each declarative runs on the unsuccessful operation, whichever word spells it

probes.printed: exit 0 for ERROR and EXCEPTION on files, EXTEND, OUTPUT, I-O and INPUT, with and without STANDARD and ON

probes.expected: the format takes one of the two words

probes.printed: at 85 COBOL0900 without the word PROCEDURE requires COBOL-2002; at 2023 exit 0

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR4  (4.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR4
OK  §1985:VII.4.6.4 GR5  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: The synonymy holds by construction: the grammar's (EXCEPTION | ERROR) alternation feeds one DeclBindUse path that never reads which token was written. The 1985-only required words AFTER and PROCEDURE are enforced by the version pass.

refuter.evidence: u1.cob: USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR ON SQ plus USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION ON SQ refused COBOL0897 (SR3 treats the two words as one condition); USE AFTER ERROR INPUT plus USE AFTER EXCEPTION INPUT refused COBOL0897 (SR6). u2.cob (runs/u2-001): the 1985 IPC form USE GLOBAL AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION ON SQ and USE GLOBAL AFTER ERROR I-O in the outer program fire for a contained program's failed OPEN INPUT SQ and OPEN I-O RL (35 each), control returns and BACK prints. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR4 'The words ERROR and EXCEPTION are synonymous'; OK §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR3 'The same file-name must not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement'; OK §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR6 'may each be specified only once in the declaratives portion'.
